# Independent array components and a binary map result

Independently authored Java8 declarations retain K[], V[], a primitive boolean
and Map<K,V>. Frozen observers check exact array/flag references, aliased and
covariant arrays, nulls/bounds/ArrayStoreException, partial writes, runtime/Error
identity, opaque results and ignored calls. Source and SDK modes compile every
output and compare original metadata, roles, Exceptions and helpers. No private
application bytes or behavior are included.
